main_text.p: 1. Tim. 1. 4. Et ad ordinandos presbyteros, Tit.1. Dico Episcopos ab Apostolis constitu-tos supra presbyteros ad hæc officia. Hoc Apostolorum factum Hieronymus vocat consuetudinem Ecclesiæ, non autem Dominicam dispositionem. Nisi hæc ita intelligantur, nec Hieronymus sibi ipse constare poterit, nec superiora Scripturæ loca componi possunt.

At, inquiunt, nisi hæc res definita fuisset post illa tempora, de quibus loquitur Augustinus, non est credibile, Alexandrinos ordinare voluisse sine Episcopis. Quibus verbis probare contendunt, hoc institutum fuisse in generali Concilio, & hoc Concilium fuisse post Augustini tempora.

Respondeo : Loquitur Augustinus de re, quæ apud Alexandrinos in vsu fuerat, viuen-te iam Augustino. ( Si tamen liber ille sit Augustini, quod ne Pontificii quidem censores agnoscunt.) Sed vt demusfuisse. Loquitur de re, quæ in vsu fuerat Augustino viuente. At Hieronymus Augustino antiquior, loquitur de antiqua Ecclesiæ consuetudine, quæ multis ante ipsum seculis duraverat. Et ante Hieronymum Cyprianus & Irenæus testantur, Episcopos ab Apostolis instituto s, & in Ecclesia regenda, esse Apostolorum successores. Videte, in quantas angustias viri docti se coniiciant? Nam si hæc res definita fuerat in Concilio generali post Augustini tempora, quomodo potuit esse antiqua Ecclesiæ consuetudo ante Hieronymi tempora? Si interrogent,

page.notes: The first paragraph is marked cont="true" because the line begins at the margin without an indent, so it probably continues from the previous page; this is uncertain. The page number "280" is an old-style numeral that I read as 280 with doubt. The word "demusfuisse" and the word "Loquiturde" (now "Loquitur de") appear with missing spaces in print; I have kept the printed spacing as far as I can see it, so "demusfuisse" is a likely printing error (for "demus fuisse"). "instituto s" is printed with a stray space and is kept as printed in the reading "instituto s"; it is probably "institutos". Small dots and a mark in the left margin are not text and are not transcribed. The sliver of the right-hand page is not transcribed.
